QUOTE: "It is triggered from the failed-post indicator (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`, `Failed.onPress`)." and "a failed send is never retried automatically. The post is kept locally, marked failed, and the user retries it by hand." and "(`retryFailedPost`, `app/actions/remote/post.ts:228`)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry happens only manually, triggered from the failed-post indicator's onPress, and names retryFailedPost. It doesn't quote the "Try Again" label, but the user-initiated retry on the failed post is the substance.
